ruleset.name: search-ranking
ruleset.description: Size/complexity rules for spryker-community/search-ranking. Runs alongside phpmd-public-methods.xml and phpmd-class-complexity.xml as SEPARATE phpmd invocations — PHPMD merges every loaded ruleset's exclude-pattern into one global file-ignore list for a single run, so keeping each Facade/Factory exemption in its own ruleset (run separately) is the only way to exempt just that one rule without also hiding Facades/Factories from the per-method rules below, which stay fully enforced even on Facade/Factory files. ExcessiveClassComplexity (a class-wide sum, not a per-method rule) lives in phpmd-class-complexity.xml instead — see that file's description.
